headline: Mamadou Sangare challenges Brentford to aim for 'top two' Premier League finish
description: Mamadou Sangare has challenged Brentford to cause a "real surprise" and push for a top two finish in the Premier League this season.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Martínez's future at Man United in doubt after bust-up
description: Lisandro Martínez's future at Manchester United is in question after he pointed fingers at the club's board. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Why does Haaland score so many goals? Because he's elite at staying onside
description: We know what a dominant scorer Erling Haaland is, but it often goes unnoticed how good he is at avoiding a striker's worst enemy: the offside trap.

headline: Lisandro Martínez: I believe in 'everyone working to help' Man United 'move forward'
description: Lisandro Martínez has said he believes in "my teammates, our manager and everyone working to help this club move forward."

headline: Sources: Man United assessing Martínez comments as player releases statement
description: Manchester United bosses are assessing Lisandro Martínez's comments in the aftermath of the 2-0 defeat to Atletico Madrid before deciding whether to take disciplinary action against the Argentina defender, sources have told ESPN.
